# Dashboard widgets

- **layer** organism
- **source** —
- **status** n/a

`components/widgets` — card-framed rows of Statistic and StatsWithPercentage molecules, a chart card (`chart.js` via `react-chartjs-2`), the credits/quota widget and the listing-count widget. Each widget owns its own loading skeleton and its own empty state (`listings-count-dashboard`, `analytics-dashboard`, `quota-credits-dashboard`).
